# Incident Report: Overnight Refrigeration Failure at Rosewood Street Bakery

**Report ID:** RSB-2024-017
**Date of Incident:** March 14–15, 2024
**Prepared by:** Operations Review Team
**Distribution:** Owner, Kitchen Manager, Maintenance Contractor, All Shift Leads

---

## Summary

At approximately 11:40 p.m. on March 14, the walk-in cooler at Rosewood Street Bakery experienced a compressor failure that went undetected until staff arrived at 4:15 a.m. the following morning. Internal temperatures rose from a normal 38°F to 61°F over roughly four and a half hours. All temperature-sensitive inventory was discarded as a precaution, resulting in a loss of approximately $3,400 in product and a delayed opening of two hours. No customers received affected product, and no illness was reported.

This report reconstructs the event, examines the contributing factors, and recommends changes to prevent recurrence. Our review found this was a system failure, not an individual one. Several reasonable decisions, each defensible on its own, combined to leave the cooler unprotected overnight.
